qualification.education_qualification: Post Graduate Degree with B.Ed. for PGTs, Graduate Degree with B.Ed. and TET for TGTs, specific subject combinations required.
qualification.details: PGT (Mathematics): Integrated Post Graduate Course from NCTE recognised institutions, in the concerned subject with at least 50% marks in aggregate including B.Ed. component. PGT (Economics): Master Degree from a recognized institution with at least 50% marks in aggregate in the subject concerned. AND B.Ed. Degree from NCTE recognized institution with at least 50% marks. PGT (Sociology): Master Degree from a recognized institution with at least 50% marks in aggregate in the subject concerned. AND B.Ed. Degree from NCTE recognized institution with at least 50% marks. PGT (Commerce): Master Degree from a recognized institution with at least 50% marks in aggregate in the subject concerned. AND B.Ed. Degree from NCTE recognized institution with at least 50% marks. PGT (Computer Science): M.Sc. (Computer Science / IT) / MCA from recognized institution with at least 50% marks. OR M.E. or M.Tech (Computer Science/IT) from recognized institution with at least 50% marks. AND B.Ed. degree from NCTE Recognized institution with at least 50% marks. TGT (Science): Four years integrated degree course from NCTE recognized institution with at least 50% marks in the concerned subject(s) as well as in the aggregate including B.Ed. component. TGT (Social Studies): Bachelors/Honors Degree from a recognized institution with at least 50% marks in concerned subject, combination of subjects as well as in the aggregate and B.Ed. Degree from NCTE recognized institution with at least 50% marks. TGT (Sanskrit): Graduation level and three years integrated B.Ed.-M.Ed from NCTE recognized institution with at least 50% marks.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for Atal Residential School Azamgarh Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 07/09/2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Atal Residential School Azamgarh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the Guest Faculty Teachers (PGT/TGT) posts is 07 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Guest Faculty Teachers?
faq.answer: There are a total of 11 vacancies for Guest Faculty Teachers (PGT/TGT) posts announced by Atal Residential School Azamgarh for the academic year 2026-27.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for PGT posts?
faq.answer: For PGT posts, candidates need to have a Post Graduate Degree with a B.Ed. degree. Specific subject combinations are also required as per the detailed notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Guest Faculty Teacher positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts is 50 years as of 01 July 2026. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for PGT and TGT posts?
faq.answer: The salary for PGT posts ranges from 35750 to 36000 per month, and for TGT posts, it is 34125 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is via email. Candidates need to send their application form and required documents to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Guest Faculty Teacher roles?
faq.answer: The selection process includes Document Verification, a Personal Talk, and an Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in these stages.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article. It contains all the detailed information about the recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q10. Which subjects are available for PGT and TGT posts?
faq.answer: The available subjects for PGT posts include Mathematics, Economics, Sociology, Commerce, and Computer Science. For TGT posts, Science, Social Studies, and Sanskrit are available.
